name: omarchy-breaktime
description: Omarchy plugin: reminds you to drink water and stretch. Snooze 5 min.
author: Edgars Mjasnikovs

scripts.lint: prettier --log-level warn --write 'src/**/*.mts' 'test/**/*.ts' && eslint --fix src test && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: prettier --check 'src/**/*.mts' 'test/**/*.ts' && eslint src test && tsc --noEmit && bun test
scripts.prepublish: bun run check && bun run build && bash scripts/prepublish.sh
